summary: Today’s briefing highlights key legal developments and significant retail earnings amid a challenging market environment for Indian businesses.

bullets.text: Shoppers Stop reported a 7% increase in Q2 FY27 revenue to Rs 1,618 crore, marking a return to profitability.
Bajaj Finance anticipates a 29% rise in net profit for Q2 FY27, driven by strong loan demand.
DIIs increased their stakes in 8 midcap stocks during Q2 FY27, reflecting confidence in midcap performance.
The Supreme Court issued eight rulings concerning arrest, cheque bounce, and contempt in SCC Vol. 8 Part 2.
Nine of the top ten most valued firms saw a market capitalization increase of Rs 3.65 lakh crore last week.
